text:
Still Working On The Deagel Report Specific Input Factors
lets try 2 covid vaccine doses into a simplified formula...
Still crunching the numbers. Still working. Still thinking. Still at the grind. I used to build ships stuck in bottles, then shove them full up my ass once completed. Everyone has their hobbies.
This is keeping my attention at the moment. Everything still locks. And locks in tight. Here I use 2 covid death shots, rather than just 1. Seeing what it does to the overall toxicity profile, and hence, the cumulative death rate projections. The LLM’s are not very good at extrapolating out the long term toxicity rates of what was in the fucking covid death shots. Probably because at least 55-62 fucking elements were in those god damn jabs. And the whole thing runs off EMF based activation. Calculating that type of harm to a human is now truly Novel.
I didn’t type in my full formula (The Atreyu Method), cause I was just typing it out quick, and I fucking hate typing.
As I’ve stated, which needs to be retold for emphasis: I tried the top 11 LLM’s out there, and they all refused to do the simple calculations. Just straight shut down. No warning. No I’m sorry. No connection lost. No try again later. No inappropriate material. No violation of search terms. No dangerous material. No browser not compatible. No internet access issue. No nothing whatsoever.
I found one… only fucking one… where I can go to the homepage, load in my question, and hit enter. It will answer that initial question. Then it’s gone. Shut down cold like all the others. Thus - I get one fucking shot at this, with only one fucking question answered. And I ain’t no Good Will Hunting math asshole that can run all those numbers in my head. Obviously, that is what we created modelling software for.
Except here… the software is refusing to do the work (lol). What a fucking world!
Back to it… lets see how two covid jabs works in a simplified model
“Q: Take covid19 vaccine database: howbadismybatch.com. Compare to The Deagel 2025 Depopulation Report/Forecast and death numbers noted. Take specific batches from EN or EL series for comparison. Use this formula: (1) take countries native population, and filter out immigrant population; (2) calculate specific targeted vaccine compliance expected rates of each country; (3) then multiply by the death rates of those series of vaccines. But use two dose toxicity profile, as covid vaccines were always a two dose deal. Create chart. Deagel Report on left, This Method on right. Take the ten highest death rate countries listed in Deagel Report. That is what you are comparing.”
Well fuck my hole with a clipper ship, and forget the bottle! Look at that. Again - a god damn air tight fucking lock! Who woulda guessed it? Gee, I don’t know… fucking everyone!
So… maybe we move past all the bullshit… and you just realize… your worst nightmares… ain’t bad enough! Not even close.
Of fucking course!
Did you think it wouldn’t?
At some point… people will realize what they did to all us. What they are doing to us. Why they are doing it. And who (or what) is really doing it. Because this shit right here… this is what full-on demonic demented psychopathic insanity looks like. But even that… that isn’t a strong enough descriptor for this type of evil. Remember hearing: “safe & effective?” Yeah heard that once or twice, didn’t ya? And never forget… they were sitting on this fucking data, while they fucking told you that incessantly.
This is what it looks like when humanity (the rulers/controllers of it anyway) become fully inverted from humanity… and fucking reality.
So no… the words I chose to describe this evilness, do not fucking fit. Not even fucking close!
-atreyu
